Gen Butlers Hd Qrs May 26 1864
Maj Eckert Di  9.30 P. M.
from Snake Rosalie may harrow plague for Jacob
unity no irregularities have been reported to me
at famish or animal please indicate what they
are and they shall receive immediate attention Knox
R OBrien


Hd Qrs Genl Butler May 26 1864
10 PM
Maj Eckert Di
Snake may harrow pledge Rosalie for Jonah unity Wrangle
of Emily today received Zodiac orders already given this
morning to put say glory promise squash in condition
to move at once leaving what may be sufficient
in the judgement of myself and officers to hold
the line of defences between the Bergen & oppo
Mattox near point of rocks which is our quackive
line zodiac you say hold the Bergen to blubber 
is it intended to abandon this line and retire
to city point unity this will be a work
of time to save the gov't material and men 
zodiac general Meigs Can Explain the defences at all
events send transportation for the movement which has been
ordered to Washington Knox nothing new all well
R OBrien
